headline: Divi's Laboratories Q2 Net Profit Surges 64% to Rs 1,127 Crore
hook: Strongest quarterly jump in recent quarters
summary: Divi's Laboratories reported a 63.6% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 1,127 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations rose 35.4% to Rs 3,676 crore compared to Rs 2,715 crore in the same period last fiscal. The pharmaceutical company also posted a foreign exchange gain of Rs 24 crore during the quarter. Shares settled at Rs 10,305 apiece, up 1.53% ahead of the results.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings growth boosts pharma sector sentiment and shareholder value.
